en: 1 Chronicles 16

p.src: 1  They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

en: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
u.src: 1  They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

p.src: 2  When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD’s name.

en: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD’s name.
u.src: 2  When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD’s name.

p.src: 3  He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.

en: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
u.src: 3  He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.

p.src: 4  He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the LORD’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:

en: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the LORD’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:
u.src: 4  He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the LORD’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:

p.src: 5  Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;

en: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;
u.src: 5  Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;

p.src: 6  with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.

en: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
u.src: 6  with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.

p.src: 7  Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.

en: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.
u.src: 7  Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.

p.src: 8  Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.

en: Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.
u.src: 8  Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.

p.src: 9  Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.

en: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.
u.src: 9  Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.

p.src: 10  Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

en: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
u.src: 10  Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

p.src: 11  Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

en: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
u.src: 11  Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

p.src: 12  Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth, 13  you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

zh: 他僕人以色列的後裔， 他所揀選雅各的子孫哪， 你們要記念他奇妙的作為和他的奇事， 並他口中的判語。
en: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
u.src: 12  Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth, 13  you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

en: 16:13 or, seed

p.src: 14  He is the LORD our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

en: He is the LORD our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
u.src: 14  He is the LORD our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

p.src: 15  Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

en: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
u.src: 15  Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

p.src: 16  the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.

en: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.
u.src: 16  the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.

p.src: 17  He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

en: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
u.src: 17  He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

p.src: 18  saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”

en: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”
u.src: 18  saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”

p.src: 19  when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

en: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
u.src: 19  when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

p.src: 20  They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

en: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
u.src: 20  They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

p.src: 21  He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

en: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
u.src: 21  He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

p.src: 22  “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

en: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
u.src: 22  “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

p.src: 23  Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.

en: Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.
u.src: 23  Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.

p.src: 24  Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.

en: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.
u.src: 24  Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.

p.src: 25  For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.

en: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.
u.src: 25  For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.

p.src: 26  For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

en: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
u.src: 26  For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

p.src: 27  Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.

en: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.
u.src: 27  Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.

p.src: 28  Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!

en: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!
u.src: 28  Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!

p.src: 29  Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.

en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.
u.src: 29  Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.

p.src: 30  Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.

en: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.
u.src: 30  Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.

p.src: 31  Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “The LORD reigns!”

en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “The LORD reigns!”
u.src: 31  Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “The LORD reigns!”

p.src: 32  Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!

en: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!
u.src: 32  Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!

p.src: 33  Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth.

en: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth.
u.src: 33  Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth.

p.src: 34  Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

en: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
u.src: 34  Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

p.src: 35  Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”

en: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”
u.src: 35  Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”

p.src: 36  Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.

en: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.
u.src: 36  Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.

zh: 在耶路撒冷和基遍的敬拜

p.src: 37  So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;

en: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;
u.src: 37  So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;

p.src: 38  and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;

en: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;
u.src: 38  and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;

p.src: 39  and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon, 40  to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the LORD’s law, which he commanded to Israel;

zh: 且派祭司撒督和他弟兄眾祭司在基遍的邱壇、耶和華的帳幕前燔祭壇上，每日早晚，照着耶和華律法書上所吩咐以色列人的，常給耶和華獻燔祭。
en: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,
to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the LORD’s law, which he commanded to Israel;
u.src: 39  and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon, 40  to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the LORD’s law, which he commanded to Israel;

p.src: 41  and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever;

en: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever;
u.src: 41  and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever;

p.src: 42  and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.

en: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.
u.src: 42  and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.

p.src: 43  All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.

en: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.
u.src: 43  All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.
